topic: How can satellite link budgets be optimized for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage?
consensus_response: Satellite link budgets can be optimized by integrating advanced routing algorithms, dynamic resource allocation, and innovative network architectures. Beamforming and phased array antennas enhance signal quality, reducing interference and latency. Orbital diversity and inter-satellite links further optimize throughput and latency.
reference_context: QoS-OSPF with RSVP enhances path selection, considering bandwidth and latency, while DVB-S2 and PCE support dynamic resource allocation and traffic routing.
